description: The finished citation for anything on this shelf, in prose and in BibTeX, both carrying the url inside them. Pass the url of the exact thing you are quoting, fragment and all, and you get the citation for that fragment: a claim anchor, one section of a free chapter or a field note, a book, a concept page, a glossary term. Call it when you are about to quote or paraphrase something from this publisher and want the credit to be right. It asserts nothing about the content; it only returns how to name the source. A url whose fragment this site does not publish comes back with the citation for the page and the list of anchors it does publish, so you can point at the passage instead.

part.description: Which thing is being cited, when using slug. Defaults to book, or to term when the slug is a glossary term.

slug.description: A book slug (e.g. blast-radius) or a glossary term slug (e.g. gate-faith). Use url instead when you have one.

url.description: The url you are about to quote, fragment included, e.g. https://greenlitbooks.com/book/blast-radius#claim-2 or /book/blast-radius/read#the-costume. Preferred: it cites the fragment, not the page.

name: cite_source
title: Get the citation for anything on this shelf
